tests.description: Reference: WRF 4.8 em_scm_xy COLD-SEASON single-column run, data/eqwefic/noahcold_scm, dumped by ctessum-claude/WRF branch earthsciml-instrumented-noahcold (commit 4695cee3) and replayed through the real64 (-fdefault-real-8) kernels/noah_driver at ESM_DT = 1e-6 s. SNOPAC's closure is evaluated on the INPUT column -- t12 and everything it selects are formed before the pack or the soil are advanced -- so the only dt dependence reaching these quantities is through df1 and the incoming pack, and 1e-6 s is the right reference step, the same choice the soil-heat surface closure makes. THE MELT RATE IS REFERENCED BEFORE ITS LIMITER: `ex` is asserted against the replay's `sno_ex_raw`, the rate SNOPAC forms from the energy residual, and NOT against the post-limiter `sno_ex` or against a snow-amount difference. That publisher exists because differencing the pack would put this quantity in exactly the cancellation-versus-clamping bind that FORTRAN_BUGS N97 documents for the frozen-soil sink; referencing the pre-limiter rate avoids it entirely. The two limiters themselves are PROJECTIONS of the state after a step, not parts of the rate, and are reported as the indicators `pack_exhausted` and `melt_limited` rather than folded in. Step 101 of case A, snow accumulating onto initially bare frozen ground; SNOPAC takes its sub-freezing block.
